transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Hi, thank you. Well, what brings me in is that I just keep getting these awful doubts that I've missed something important. 

It happens with all sorts of things—like a number on the mortgage payment, or a clause in a client proof for my work, or even just a door not being latched at home. And the frustrating part is, even when I know I've already checked it, the thought just barges right back into my head. It's like this constant worry of... what if this is the mistake that costs you everything? It's just become really hard to deal with on my own.

When these doubts come up, do you find yourself doing specific things—like checking repeatedly or going through certain mental steps—to try to reduce the worry or prevent something bad from happening?

Yes, I do. I... well, I end up reopening files over and over. I'll reread emails, or keep going back to check an online payment confirmation just to be absolutely sure. Sometimes I also find myself saying the numbers or figures silently in my head until they finally feel... settled, I guess. 

It's really impacting my work. A simple invoice or a basic logo revision can turn into hours of checking, and obviously, those are hours I just can't bill a client for.
Do these doubts or worries ever come into your mind as thoughts that feel intrusive or unwanted, rather than just normal concerns about making a mistake?

Yes, exactly. Like I mentioned a few minutes ago, they really do just barge right in. It's not like I'm sitting there choosing to worry about a client proof or a mortgage payment. I don't want those thoughts there at all. 

I can be totally aware that I've already checked something—like the door latch—and the doubt still forces its way into my mind anyway. It's just this awful, intrusive dread of... well, like I said, 'what if this is the mistake that costs you everything?' So, yes, they definitely feel completely unwanted. It's not just normal double-checking.
